statement.text:
Let $X$ be a compact, totally disconnected subset of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ with
$|X| \geq 2$, and let $\Gamma_{X}$ denote the mapping class group of $\mathbb{R}^{2} - X$.
(a) For $Y \subset X$, let $\Gamma_{X,Y}$ be the subgroup of $\Gamma_{X}$ permuting $Y$ . Classify in-
variants $q$ that are functorial.
(b) If $X \subset \mathbb{R}^{2}$ is totally disconnected and $\alpha$ is a homeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ fixing
$X$ as a set, let $C_{\alpha}(X)$ denote the space of $\alpha$-invariant closed subsets of

$X$, in the Hausdorff topology. Let $q$ be functorial as in part (a). Classify
those $q$ that are continuous or semi-continuous.
(c) What is the relationship between the translation length $\tau_{X}$ and topological
entropy? More precisely, is there a positive constant $C$ so that if $\alpha$ is a
homeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ permuting $X$ and $g$ is the class of $\alpha$ in $\Gamma_{X}$, then
the (topological) entropy of $\alpha$ is at least as big as $C \cdot \tau_{X}(g)$?
(d) Suppose $X$ is a Cantor set in the plane, and let $P\Gamma_{X}$ denote the ‘pure’
subgroup of $\Gamma_{X}$ fixing $X$ pointwise. Let $N$ be a subgroup of $P\Gamma_{X}$ that is
normal in $\Gamma_{X}$, and for each integer $n$, let $N_{n}$ be the subgroup of $P\Gamma_{n}$ that
is the image of $N$ restricted to any $n$-element subset of $X$. What possible
sequences of subgroups $N_{n}$ can arise in this way?
(e) For which $g \in \Gamma_{X}$ is there an embedding $X \to \mathbb{R}^{2}$ for which $g$ is represented
by a diffeomorphism $\alpha$ which is $C^{\infty}$? Or $C^{k}$ for fixed $k$?
